author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
On the 5th of June I released a video called "This Video Is JUST Adverts". This was youtubes first video that had an advert placed every single second of the video. In total the video was 7 hours and 44 minutes long featuring around 28,000 advert approved slots. Now if 1 million people watched all of those adverts then surely I the spiffing brit would now be a multi millionaire enjoying retirement in the sun. So this video exists to break down what happened in the "This Video Is JUST Ads" video and how much money we made, what happened to all the ads and did the ad only video work in the expected way! 

Want to try Vidiq Here you go: https://vidiq.com/spiff

Want to listen to the music in this video: https://deepforge.co/britishambience

This video is a perfectly balanced youtube video meaning that I the spiffing brit have created something that is exclusively designed to break the youtube algorithm or just create something that is absurd and no one else would logically try and attemp
title: What Happened To All The Ads?
